translation_notes: the draft's prefix name `owl-ns:` (derived from the OWL_NS variable) is unusable outside islands, where `-` stays subtraction; renamed to `owl:` (hyphenated prefixes are declarable but only usable inside g{} islands)

`OWL_NS = Namespace("http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#")` and the `from rdflib import Namespace` line it needs are replaced by `@prefix owl: <...> .` on the ldpy side; OWL_NS is context and is not used anywhere else in the region

`operator=owl:intersectionOf` as a default argument value and `[owl:intersectionOf, owl:unionOf]` inside Python list literals both resolve as prefixed names (the documented `arr[ex:b]` residual collision works in our favour here)
original.py needed `from rdflib import Namespace` added: the extractor kept the OWL_NS assignment but not the import it needs

context shim: Class and OWLRDFListProxy imported from rdflib.extras.infixowl (upstream of the vendored copy) because the vendored module starts with `from rdflib import py3compat`, removed in rdflib 6; their __init__ bodies differ from the vendored ones only in formatting. Identical import on both sides
no triple-add island in this region: it only names terms, so the ldpy gain is limited to the prefixed names
